game: The Last of Us Part I
source: Part I src/menu.cpp and settings registry. Controls depend on verified game bindings and the loaded scene. Part II coming soon.

items.label: Lock-on
items.desc: Adjusts aim toward the selected target.
settings: Aim key: Hold, Toggle or Always

items.label: Silent aim
items.desc: Separate aim mode using the supported internal firing path. Availability depends on the active game build.
settings: Field of view and target range

items.label: Auto target
items.desc: Acquire a native target while aiming your weapon in Lock-on mode.

items.label: Aim overlays
items.desc: Configure the aim field-of-view circle and target indicator.

items.label: Triggerbot
items.desc: Fire when a valid target is under the crosshair.

items.label: Box
items.desc: Frame characters with a full or corner box.
settings: Corner boxes inside the Box settings

items.label: Name
items.desc: Display the character name.

items.label: Distance
items.desc: Show distance from your character.

items.label: Health bar
items.desc: Display available character health.

items.label: Health text
items.desc: Show the numeric health value where health data is available.

items.label: Skeleton
items.desc: Draw live character bones when verified bone data is available.

items.label: Head marker
items.desc: Mark the character head.

items.label: Snaplines
items.desc: Draw a line from the screen to characters.

items.label: Independent styles
items.desc: NPC and self appearance are configured separately.

items.label: NPC filters
items.desc: Filter humans, friendlies, runners, stalkers, clickers, bloaters and other NPCs.

items.label: Drawing distance
items.desc: Limit the range of displayed entities.

items.label: Item ESP
items.desc: Display names, distance labels and markers for supported loaded pickups.

items.label: Weapon ESP
items.desc: Configure weapon pickups independently, with colors and distance limits.

items.label: Sky color
items.desc: Set sky tint and intensity.

items.label: Remove fog
items.desc: Reduce fog through the supported world binding.

items.label: Full bright
items.desc: Adjust scene lighting where supported.

items.label: Godmode
items.desc: Prevent player damage through the supported game binding.

items.label: Infinite sprint
items.desc: Remove the supported sprint limitation.

items.label: Ignore me
items.desc: Block AI sight and hearing together; existing alerts and scripted encounters may still react.

items.label: Invisible to AI
items.desc: Disable supported AI sight checks.

items.label: Inaudible to AI
items.desc: Disable supported AI hearing checks.

items.label: Noclip
items.desc: Move through the scene using flight controls.

items.label: Super run
items.desc: Adjust the movement multiplier from 1x to 5x.

items.label: Freecam
items.desc: Move the camera independently.

items.label: Teleport NPCs to me
items.desc: Bring loaded human NPCs into rows ahead of you.

items.label: Teleport infected to me
items.desc: Bring loaded infected into rows ahead of you.

items.label: Teleport to checkpoint
items.desc: Move to an available checkpoint position.

items.label: Save my position
items.desc: Store your current position for a later return.

items.label: Return to saved position
items.desc: Return to the saved position.

items.label: Cancel teleport
items.desc: Cancel a pending teleport request.

items.label: Infinite ammo
items.desc: Preserve ammunition through the internal ammo hooks.

items.label: No reload
items.desc: Preserve loaded ammunition so supported weapons do not need to reload.

items.label: Faster reload
items.desc: Adjust reload speed from 1x to 5x.

items.label: Rapid fire
items.desc: Use the native 3x firing cadence. Semi-automatic weapons still need separate trigger presses.

items.label: No recoil
items.desc: Reduce supported recoil behavior.

items.label: No spread
items.desc: Remove the player shot cone through the internal firing hook.

items.label: Best accuracy
items.desc: Reduce movement accuracy penalties.

items.label: No weapon sway
items.desc: Reduce weapon sway.

items.label: Infinite throwables
items.desc: Use the game’s Infinite Craftables behavior; it does not grant missing items.

items.label: Infinite crafting
items.desc: Preserve supported crafting resources.

items.label: Infinite melee durability
items.desc: Preserve melee weapon durability.

items.label: Items and ammo
items.desc: Browse and search pickup definitions, including ammunition.

items.label: Guns
items.desc: Browse firearm pickups in the Weapons sub-tab.

items.label: Melee weapons
items.desc: Browse melee weapon pickups.

items.label: Selected pickup
items.desc: Review the selected definition and request a spawn near the player.

items.label: Human NPCs
items.desc: Browse available character archetypes.

items.label: Infected
items.desc: Choose infected archetypes, including runners, stalkers, clickers and bloaters when available.

items.label: Character loadout
items.desc: Choose supported spawn and equipment options.

items.label: Catalog availability
items.desc: Character resources depend on the loaded level. Missing resources remain unavailable rather than spawning an invalid actor.

items.label: UI scale
items.desc: Scale the menu from 50% to 200%, with automatic fitting to the viewport.

items.label: Overlay scale
items.desc: Scale HUD elements independently from the menu.

items.label: Languages
items.desc: English, Spanish, French, German and Brazilian Portuguese.

items.label: Color pickers
items.desc: Inline color controls with an alpha strip.

items.label: Menu controls
items.desc: F1 or Insert opens the menu by default.

items.label: Feature bindings
items.desc: Search features and assign keyboard or mouse bindings.

items.label: Activation modes
items.desc: Choose Hold, Toggle or Always for supported features.

items.label: Hotkey overlay
items.desc: Show assigned keys and activation information.

items.label: Control indicator
items.desc: Plain-text movement controls for active features such as noclip and freecam.

items.label: Named profiles
items.desc: Create, rename, save, load, reset and delete configurations.

items.label: Default config
items.desc: Choose a profile to use by default.

items.label: Clipboard configs
items.desc: Import and export configuration text.

items.label: Watermark
items.desc: Display product and frame-rate information.

items.label: Crosshair
items.desc: Customize crosshair size and appearance.
